description: This file defines an abstract class HTMLPurifier_Token_Tag, which is part of an HTML purifier library. The class manages tag tokens such as start, end, or empty tags, including properties like tag name, attributes, and related functionality.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Token_Tag
classes.description: An abstract class representing an HTML tag token, with properties for tag name, attributes, and behaviors pertinent to HTML tag tokens.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a tag token object, normalizing the tag name to lowercase and the attribute keys to lowercase.

methods.name: toNode
methods.description: Converts the token into an HTMLPurifier_Node_Element object.
